clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police Initiate Ethics Probes Into Wiretap Case
aiSummaryBullets: The National Police are holding ethics hearings for individuals, including a high-ranking officer, linked to the suspected surveillance of the President.
The National Police Chief has implemented personnel transfers involving senior commissioners amidst the ongoing investigation.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Discusses Resignation With Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka confirmed he discussed his intention to resign from office with President Prabowo Subianto.
President Prabowo reportedly advised Gibran to continue addressing legal challenges regarding his educational documents in court.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Bestows National Hero Titles To 19 Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded the National Hero title to 19 individuals during a formal ceremony at the State Palace.
The list of recipients includes historical figures such as R.M. Margono Djojohadikusumo, Hoegeng Iman Santoso, and Ali Sadikin.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Formalize Support For Opinion Rights On Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have signed a proposal to invoke the right to express an opinion regarding the Vice President.
The initiative includes participation from members of various parties, including Golkar, though Gerindra has yet to join the list of signatories.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Invalidates Education Equivalency Certificate Of Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court declared the education equivalency certificate of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka void and legally invalid.
The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education has been ordered by the Court to revoke the previously issued equivalency documentation.

clusters.headline: Three Prominent PSI Leaders Resign To Focus On Government Roles
aiSummaryBullets: High-ranking members Giring Ganesha, Raja Juli Antoni, and Isyana Bagoes Oka have formally stepped down from the Indonesian Solidarity Party.
The officials cited the need to dedicate their full attention to their respective responsibilities within the government.

clusters.headline: Calls For Impeachment And Resignation Of Gibran Rakabuming Raka Grow
aiSummaryBullets: Student protesters demonstrated at the DPR building demanding the impeachment of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Members of the PKS party have publicly advocated for the Vice President's resignation or a formal legislative review process.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Ministers Highlight Education Goals And National Unity
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister for Politics and Security Dudung Abdurachman urged citizens to uphold national unity in honor of Hero's Day.
Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Sugiono distributed stationery to over 700 elementary schools in Tangerang.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General Office Names PT BSJ As Nickel Case Suspect
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office designated PT Bumi Sentosa Jaya as a corporate suspect in a nickel corruption case in Southeast Sulawesi.
Investigators identified Arif Kurniawan, the beneficial owner of the mining company, as a central figure in the ongoing probe.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Announces Winners Of The Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta provincial government recognized various individuals for their contributions to local waste management initiatives.
Winners were selected across multiple categories, including environmental activists and social media influencers.
